what: Small widgets (View work, Newsletter, Address) hung on each section in the 250px right side panel of the body scroll up in place until they reach the stacking line below the header (64px by default), where they stick, and the next section’s widget stacks beneath the stuck one in turn. There is only one stack across the page, so widgets gather in the side panel as you pass each section. There is no curve, it is tied directly to scroll (moved in the scroll event, so no one-frame lag), and on narrow screens (below 900) it stays in place.

options.[data-fx-part=widget]: Widgets to attach to the side panel (multiple, required) — stacked in the order listed
options.top: Distance from the top of the screen where stacking begins, in px, default 64 — use the value of the first row that appears on the page
options.min: Below this width (px) it stays in place instead of sticking, default 900

use: View work
note: The widget sits inside the row as absolute and is moved down by translateY only as much as it touches the stacking line under the header — with fixed, keyboard focus on an offscreen widget link wouldn’t scroll the page there. The row (element) is placed by the consuming side at the right side-panel spot of that section (add relative if there is no position).

from.where: shared.js side panel widget (original widget-bar·widget-element — position fixed, side panel 12.5rem − 1rem×2, stacked .75rem below the header with .5rem between widgets)
